messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: HIGH - service=redwood-inference-api - trigger=p99_latency > SLO (threshold=10s). AlertID: PD-348712. Region: eu-west-1. link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-348712

pagerduty: Automatic page created (PD-348712). Escalation policy: oncall-eng-team. If unacked in 5m ascend to next responder.

mike (oncall): ack. I'm on call and taking this. Starting triage — checking per-region dashboards and recent deploys.

sara (eng-oncall): ack from me if it escalates. Quick check: is this global or regional? I see p95 slightly elevated across US too but p99 blow-up in EU.

liam (sre): logs -> KV cache eviction rate spiked at 11:41:12 UTC. GPU queue length climbing, backlog on sidecar. Traffic shows 2.2x baseline from a single customer prefix (hotkey).

mike (oncall): confirmed hotkey signature. Can we spin up more workers in EU pool? I'll trigger autoscale override. ETA ~= 90s.

mike (oncall): running: ```kubectl -n production scale deployment inference-runtime-eu --replicas=12```

deploy-bot: Started rollout: inference-runtime-eu -> desired replicas 12. Watch: https://k8s.example/rollouts/5678

june (customer-ops): FYI getting pings from large-enterprise-acct-42 — they report slow responses and some 503s for long prompts. Any ETA for mitigation so I can update them?

liam (sre): impact summary: p99 went to ~12.1s, p95 to ~1.9s. Error rate for long-seq requests up ~7% with timed-out generator tasks returning 503. Short prompt latency mostly OK. Root looks like hotkey + KV thrash causing cache misses and added decode time.

mike (oncall): short-term mitigation: enabling model-fallback for requests older than 2s to reduce decode times for queued requests. Toggling feature flag: `fallback_model=redwood-mini-v1` for eu region.

sara (eng-oncall): +1 to fallback. Also start prefix-warm on busiest shards. Liam, can you issue a cache-warm job?

liam (sre): running cache warm script: ```curl -X POST https://ops.example/api/warm-cache -d '{"shards":[3,7,9],"prefixes":100}'``` warming in background.

pagerduty: PD-348712 acknowledged by mike (oncall). Escalation suspended.

mike (oncall): autoscale reported new pods Ready at 11:43:40 UTC. Observability: queue length dropping. p99 trending down.

sara (eng-oncall): monitoring TL;DR: at 11:45 p99 -> 4.2s, at 11:48 -> 3.1s. Error rate dropping back toward baseline. Looks like scale + fallback + warm helped.

june (customer-ops): I've messaged large-enterprise-acct-42: "We're investigating increased latency in EU, mitigation underway. We'll follow up with root cause and ETA for full resolution in ~1h." They replied asking for a status note if we roll any config changes.

liam (sre): collected artifacts: heapdumps and kv-stats saved to s3://incident-artifacts/PD-348712/{metrics,gc,heapdump}. Also GPU-scheduler logs: /var/log/gpu-sched/2026-03-15-eu.log

mike (oncall): timeline note for PD incident: - 11:40: alert fired (p99 > 10s) - 11:41: triage start - 11:42: autoscale override - 11:42: feature-flag fallback enabled - 11:43: new pods Ready - 11:45: measurable p99 improvement - 11:50: monitoring stable, handing to sara for post-incident.

sara (eng-oncall): taking over active investigation & postmortem. Immediate actions: 1) add per-customer request cap on high-cost prefixes, 2) tune autoscaler to react faster on queue-length spikes, 3) investigate cache-shard affinity to prevent single-customer hotkey thrash. Will open tickets.

june (customer-ops): I'll prepare customer-facing incident report draft and notify affected customers with timeline + mitigation steps. Plan: send initial update in 30m, follow-up after postmortem.

mike (oncall): leaving notes in PagerDuty with timeline and links to artifacts. Handing incident to sara for RCA + follow-ups.

incident-bot: PagerDuty PD-348712 status updated -> Resolved? No, status=acknowledged. Assigned to sara (eng-oncall). Bridge: https://zoom.example/bridges/4882 (created).

sara (eng-oncall): setting postmortem owner and ETA 48h for public RCA. Short-term rollback? none. Priority fixes: rate-limiting for hot keys (P1), autoscaler tuning (P1), cache shard prefetch (P2).

liam (sre): note for postmortem: include grep of request spike: `grep -c \"acct-42/prefix-xyz\" /var/log/proxy/requests-2026-03-15.log` and attach graphs (KV evictions, pod queue length, gpu-decode-latency).

mike (oncall): resolved for oncall rotation; leaving on-call notes: if we see repeat >2x spike from same customer in 72h, trigger auto-block & sales-notify.

sara (eng-oncall): ack. I'll keep incident open for RCA. Moving thread to incidents channel summary. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
